_doc: Shared by agent/display_row_typing.py (type_display_row) and apps/desktop/src/lib/chat-messages/machine-rows.ts (typeMachineRow). A user row is a cron delivery only with machine provenance: a typed row (display_kind internal_notification or cron_delivery, or display_metadata.cron_delivery) whose text opens with a [Cronjob "<name>" output ...] frame, or an UNTYPED legacy row that opens with the exact full frame cron/scheduler_delivery.py::bot_chat_message writes (every one of the 555 legacy untyped rows in the live default store does). A person pasting or quoting a frame keeps their own bubble.

cases.name: typed producer row
cases.text:
[Cronjob "🤖 Team report | Forge" output — scheduled job, not the user. Review it, act on anything that needs action, and summarize for the chat.]

🔨 Forge Morning run is done.

cases.name: untyped legacy row with the full writer frame
cases.text:
[Cronjob "☀️ Morning brief | Neo" output — scheduled job, not the user. Review it, act on anything that needs action, and summarize for the chat.]

Good morning Tim.

cases.name: human pastes a short frame
cases.text:
[Cronjob "Team report" output - scheduled job]

Save this report for tomorrow.

cases.name: human quotes a frame inline
cases.text: [Cronjob "Team report" output] looks wrong, why did it skip Forge?
